content.summary: The integrated exposition preserves the inspected projection, cap14-to-degree15, and external-import boundaries. No new contradiction or missing premise was found in these interfaces. The H27 tree qualification is necessary and accurately limits the provenance claim. Hashes and role match; prior resolved revisions remain intact.

findings.statement: The supplied root-tree payload hashes differently from the reported tree identifier; verified text blobs do not authenticate completeness of the repository listing or the historical H27 run.
findings.disposition: Section 2 and the superseding addendum now state this distinction. H27 remains an explicit external theorem dependency, without a claim of local re-establishment.

checks.scope: High-degree projection before activating cap18 imports
checks.method: Read the integrated Sections 3-4 against D20-proof-check.md and D19-model-bridge.md, especially sections 1-3 and the marker-distinctness argument.
checks.observation: Every proper trace counts all exterior completions; binary bounds apply only to complete four-sets. Each marked member is fully represented, so its intersections with another residual and a root cone are determined by the trace. The cone contains x while residuals avoid x; identifying the other residual with the marker would force a triple to contain a four-set, so the forbidden sunflower remains distinct. The model implication requires actual markers and previously proved absences. D19 uses cap19, mu41 and universal inputs, without borrowing the later cap18-guarded package. This inspected the written bridge, not every generated matrix row.

checks.scope: Existence of an actual degree15 point before applying Theorem 2
checks.method: Checked Section 6 against LOW14-NO43-ordinary-closure.md, including the Q8 leaf argument, cross-star guards and independent graph step.
checks.observation: The cap14 branch first has universal neighbourhood upper43. If all were at most42, Jin and the A3 inverse force every fibre occupied, then b_i>=26 contradicts sum b_i=204<208. An actual N43 anchor therefore exists. Its near-link bipartite matching excludes Q8 leaves from the common triangle; all eight singleton tails consequently avoid the entire core. The chosen opposite core member proves actual 8+8 tails cross-intersect, with both centres outside both supports, satisfying the imported cross-star guard. Thus cap14 is excluded before selecting a degree15 point; the argument does not assume that point exists merely from cap15.

checks.scope: Revised H27 provenance statement versus available integrity evidence
checks.method: Read the entire revised source-scope paragraph and tree-integrity addendum; hashed the preserved 266-byte root_tree_payload.bin with the standard Git tree header and compared its preservation manifest.
checks.observation: The payload SHA256 matches its manifest and its Git SHA1 is 0a3e3838650fc981133940e798c9d220140e785e, different from the reported d4d5723267c662291efdadfa6e7061d919e76fa9. The manuscript now describes absence only from the returned listing, distinguishes matching text-blob identifiers, and disclaims historical-run authentication. The mathematical import is therefore exposed without claiming that local source inspection proves H27. I did not independently fetch the repository or replay its historical exhaustion.
